sources.title: garagelm.org · the garage intelligence lab
sources.snippet: $ about garagelm is an independent, open-source artificial intelligence research lab started in 2026, built on the hardware you'd find in a garage rather than a datacenter. The work is open source first: code, training recipes, write-ups, and weights are published wherever possible, and negative results ship alongside the wins.

sources.title: GarageLM - GitHub
sources.snippet: GarageLM The most intelligent model trainable on the cheapest hardware. Frontier labs compete at unlimited budget. GarageLM claims the opposite axis: maximum measured capability from one consumer machine — every run trained, evaluated, and served on a single Apple M4 Pro laptop chip.

sources.title: garagelm/hybrid-gpt-232m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: garagelm/hybrid-gpt-232m-mlx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: hybrid-gpt-232m-mlx float16 MLX conversion of garagelm/hybrid-gpt-232m for Apple Silicon. A 232M-parameter research model with hybrid local+global attention (sliding window w=64 on 12 of 16 layers, full causal attention on layers 3/7/11/15), pretrained on 1.0B tokens entirely on one Apple M4 Pro.

sources.title: GitHub - GarageLM/garagelm: optimize frontier training and inference ...
sources.snippet: Best case, work done at the floor pushes the frontier itself. Released weights: garagelm/hybrid-gpt-232m (base, 1B tokens) and garagelm/hybrid-gpt-232m-chat (SmolTalk SFT) — both load via transformers with trust_remote_code=True.
